$comment: Member kinds this lexicon supplies to a chant workspace (#3179). chant reads this file as data and never imports the lexicon. The Argo and Flux probes read the manifest's apiVersion and kind, so a Flux Kustomization is told apart from the kustomize one that shares its kind name. No graph blocks yet: this lexicon's kustomize reader runs kustomize, and nothing reads an Argo Application or a Flux Kustomization into the graph.

kinds.name: argo-app
kinds.description: an Argo CD Application, a manifest with apiVersion argoproj.io/* and kind Application

kinds.name: flux-kustomization
kinds.description: a Flux Kustomization, a manifest with apiVersion kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/* and kind Kustomization

kinds.name: kustomize
kinds.description: a kustomize base or overlay, with a kustomization.yaml in its directory
